rubric_points.decision: Define quality as countable good/bad events (fresh, non-defaulted, in-range inputs, intended model)
rubric_points.tradeoff: Countable and fast but only a proxy for true quality

rubric_points.decision: Fast label-free proxy SLIs: input drift, score-distribution shape, agreement with shadow/previous model; thresholds calibrated on healthy history
rubric_points.tradeoff: Early detection vs false alarms

rubric_points.decision: Slow ground-truth SLI on matured cohorts (e.g. share of weekly cohorts above a floor), accounted retroactively
rubric_points.tradeoff: Truth but three weeks late; used to audit proxies

rubric_points.decision: SLO targets over a window (e.g. 99% over 28 days) with multiwindow burn-rate alerts
rubric_points.tradeoff: Detection speed vs paging noise

rubric_points.decision: Policy text: freeze non-urgent model/feature releases when quality budget is spent, explicit exemptions, postmortem for large single burns
rubric_points.tradeoff: Release velocity vs quality protection; fairness to teams for upstream causes

rubric_points.decision: Assign accountability for upstream data (freshness checks, data contracts)
rubric_points.tradeoff: Cross-team friction vs clear ownership

rubric_points.decision: Review proxies against matured labels each quarter
rubric_points.tradeoff: Ongoing effort vs drift of proxy meaning
